messages:
emily: Heads-up: I'm assembling the docs changelog for the upcoming deploy. Need quick checks on snippets, migration notes, and known issues. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1120
raj: I'll vet the SDK snippets (Python + TS) and run the examples locally.
marco: Taking the migration checklist. Will add short rollback guidance for each breaking param.
olivia: Running link-checker now. Found 2 stale anchors on the routing policy page.
docs-bot: PR 1120 build: passed. 2 unresolved TODOs in the release-notes draft.
emily: TODOs are: 1) clarify streaming behavior for embeddings, 2) include quantized tokenization known issue with workaround.
raj: Note: TypeScript client accepts new options: region, prefetchCache. Updating snippets to reflect this.
raj: Proposed TS snippet: ```js
import {RedwoodClient}from '@redwood/inference-sdk'
const client = new RedwoodClient({apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY, region: 'eu-central-1', prefetchCache: false})
```
marco: Migration note: include table mapping old param -> new param -> mitigation (I'll push a small doc patch).
olivia: Link fixes: patched two internal anchors and filed a redirect for an external model-card URL.
jen: I'll proof the known-issues paragraph at 15:30 PT. Keep it concise.
emily: Draft known-issue: "Quantized K-format: observed tokenization drift on long prefix prompts in v1.3 quantized builds. Workaround: route to non-quantized variant or shorten prefix caching window. See issue #463."
jen: Slight edit: add 'We're investigating' and link #463. Looks good otherwise.
raj: Pushed snippet patch in PR 1121.
docs-bot: PR 1121 opened by raj  checks queued.
emily: If PR 1121 and migration table PR merge today, we can ship docs tomorrow morning. Flag any blockers here by 17:00 PT.
olivia: All link fixes merged into branch; anchors verified.
marco: Migration table PR opened: PR 1122.
emily: Thanks team ":thumbsup:" I'll post the final blurb to #marketing after jen signs off.
